pages.text: Prey grow and predators eat them: dx/dt = ax - bxy, dy/dt = -gy + dxy (Lotka-Volterra). The cycle turns around a balance point (g/d, a/b); the further you stock from it, the wider the swing, until a crash.
$(thing)Set$(): Prey, Predators.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Weather: the balance varies by +/- 2%.d.
$(thing)Limits$(): A crash: one side is dying out.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): A balanced world is fastest.
$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Prey, against balance: x / (g/d)$(br)Predators, against balance: y / (a/b)$(br)Nearness to balance: close to 1 at the balance point
